description: This file defines a class for filtering HTML elements, attributes, text, comments, and fragments within the CKEditor HTML parser. It includes methods for adding rules, filtering nodes, and applying transformations based on rules.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser.filter
classes.description: A class for filtering HTML nodes based on configurable rules within CKEditor.

methods.name: addRules
methods.description: Adds filtering rules to the filter instance with a specified priority.

methods.name: onElementName
methods.description: Filters element names based on the rules.

methods.name: onAttributeName
methods.description: Filters attribute names based on the rules.

methods.name: onElement
methods.description: Filters element nodes, applying rules for specific element names and the generic '$'.

methods.name: onNode
methods.description: Filters nodes based on their type (element, text, comment).
